response:
# API guidelines

## Deprecation
Deprecated endpoints return three headers:
- `Deprecation: true`
- `Sunset: <HTTP-date>` (the sunset date passed in)
- `Link: <https://developer.acme.example/migrate>; rel="deprecation"`
